title: since-cutoff status
description: What `since-cutoff status --json` prints: whether the notes blocks in AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md are current for the project's dependency files, decided offline (no network, no scan).

state.description: never_run: no file has a block; current: every block is current; out_of_date: at least one is not (exit_code 3).

exit_code.description: The exit code status returns: 0 current or never run, 3 out of date.

versions_from.description: Where the project's dependency versions come from now (a lockfile, requirements files, pyproject.toml, a virtual environment).

coding_agent_model.description: The model the coding agent is set up with, read from its settings; null when no setting names one.

source.description: The setting it was read from.

targets.description: One entry per instructions file (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) that has or would get a block.

file.description: The file, relative to the project.

format.description: The block's format version (1: written by 0.3); null without a block.

model.description: The model the notes were written for.

cutoff.description: The cutoff the notes were written for.

cutoff_margin.description: The margin (days before the cutoff) the notes were compared with; null without a block.

tool.description: The since-cutoff version that wrote the block.

scope.description: used or imported: what the block notes (sync --scope).

versions_from.description: Where the versions came from when the block was written.

edited.description: Whether the block was edited by hand since since-cutoff wrote it; null without a block.

packages.description: Each package the block has notes for, compared with the version the project has now.

notes_for.description: The version the notes apply to.

locked.description: The version the project has now; null when nothing pins it, or it is no longer a dependency.

versions_from.description: The file that gives that version.

state.description: current, out_of_date, orphan (no longer a dependency) or unpinned (nothing pins it, so status cannot compare it offline).

problems.description: Why the block is out of date; empty when it is current.

kind.description: What changed: stale, orphan, dependencies_changed, versions_from_changed, margin_changed, old_format, run_block, model_changed, ...

notes.description: Remarks that do not make the block out of date (a hand edit, a block from 0.3).
